text: Illustrate the story here: Gus the Dog Gus is a dog. Gus the dog is fun. Gus the dog can dig. Gus can dig in a pit. Gus dug and dug and dug. Gus dug in the mud! "Gus! Do not dig in the mud!" said Mom.
